https://unpkg.com/three@0.186.1/build/three.module.js
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.1/build/three.core.js

https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.1/examples/jsm/lines/LineMaterial.js

Local integration changes: OrbitControls.js imports './three.module.js', and
the three lines/*.js files import '../three.module.js', instead of the bare
package identifier 'three'. No import map or CDN runtime dependency is needed.
All other vendored source is unmodified. The included MIT license covers these
Three.js files, including the examples addons.
